title.text:
THE EMPEROR WHO
WALKED OUT OF THE FIRE
title.note: lock v3.2b 4.0 s on J01 only; fontSize 74 (house 88) because line 2 is 1151 px at 88 > 92% width; bandHeightPercent 14 kept

slots.vo: They pulled a burned body from the palace and called it the emperor.
slots.motion: Chronicle Reveal title (4.0 s lock, clean by 3.93 s); push 1.00->1.06 to the litter; burning roof = BIG FIRE glow pulse + spill on bearers/robes (static flame shapes); soldiers' torches flicker+spill; embers rise off the roof; warm haze

slots.vo: So why did his uncle keep searching for him?
slots.motion: push to his face; single tall candle: flame-shape sway + flicker + spill across face/robe; warm haze + lit motes

slots.vo: The emperor was Jianwen, the young grandson of the man who founded China's Ming dynasty.
slots.motion: slow drift founder->grandson; rows of candles on bronze stands: shape motion + grouped spill; haze

slots.vo: His uncles were powerful princes, and the strongest, Zhu Di, guarded the north.
slots.motion: push up to Zhu Di; wall torches: glow pulse + spill on armour/brick (torch shapes static); light snow-mist drift optional (no land warp)

slots.vo: When Jianwen began stripping his uncles of their power, Zhu Di rebelled.
slots.motion: push to edicts + courier; desk candles shape motion + spill; paper lantern flicker + gentle sway (pivot at cord)

slots.vo: After three years of war, his army reached Nanjing, the capital, and a general opened a gate to him.
slots.motion: push through the gate; massed army torches glow pulse + spill on gate leaves/brick; faint smoke haze; NO war SFX (not a battle plate)

slots.vo: Then the palace caught fire. Zhu Di's men brought a body out of the flames,
slots.motion: push toward the hall; BIG FIRE: static flame shapes, pulsing glow + spill on courtyard/roof edges; dense embers + smoke drift above roofline

slots.vo: and he buried it as the emperor. Jianwen's eldest
slots.motion: very slow push; pole torches glow pulse + spill on mourners/coffin (static torch shapes); faint smoke
slots.note: cut at L07b 'and he buried' (Edward rule); S09 cut moved to 'son,' so S08 >= 3 s

slots.vo: son, a small boy, was never seen again.
slots.motion: very slow push to the small shoes; single low candle shape motion + spill on floor/bedding; lit motes
slots.note: cut on 'son,' (override; 0.03 s word gap) so the empty room lands on the word 'son'

slots.vo: Zhu Di took the throne as the Yongle Emperor, and wiped his nephew's reign from the calendar.
slots.motion: push brazier->Yongle; candle rows shape motion; brazier = big-fire glow pulse + spill (static flame)

slots.vo: But a rumour spread that Jianwen had escaped.
slots.motion: push to the two faces; hanging paper lantern flicker + spill on faces + gentle sway

slots.vo: Yongle sent an official to search the empire for him, year after year.
slots.motion: push to Hu Ying; campfire glow pulse + spill (static flame) + REAL embers + smoke; temple lantern flicker + sway; valley mist drift

slots.vo: The official History of Ming says the treasure fleets sailed partly to find him. Most historians doubt it.
slots.motion: push across the junks; deck lanterns flicker + small sway; quay torches glow + spill; water and its reflections held STATIC (masked out of spill/mist)

slots.vo: More than twenty years after the fire, that official came back,
slots.motion: push to Hu Ying at the gate; guards' torches glow pulse + spill on him/gate; dust haze

slots.vo: and Yongle rose from bed to talk with him deep into the night.
slots.motion: push between the two faces; single low candle: shape motion + strong local spill on both faces
slots.note: cut at L13b 'and Yongle rose' (0.15 s gap -> word-start frame)

slots.vo: Only then, the history says, was Yongle's suspicion laid to rest. It never says what he was told.
slots.motion: very slow push to the door gap; light under the door flicker + spill on floor only; small candle by blank page shape motion

slots.vo: Whether Jianwen died in that fire, or walked out of it, no one has ever proved.
slots.motion: push following the figure; distant city = big-fire glow pulse (static); paper lantern flicker + sway; REAL embers drifting + smoke + ground mist

slots.vo: History remembers the victors. We remember the rest.
slots.motion: OutroHold (no text overlay, baked lettering untouched): temple lantern flicker + sway, mist + a few embers kept OUT of the lettering box; slow push only if lettering stays inside frame; music fades
